note: Vermillion County (IN) publishes its zoning only as a static PDF map (VC-Zoning-Map-Final.pdf) and UDO ordinance. The county Web GIS viewer (vermillionin.wthgis.com, WTH GIS) is linked from the surveyor and webgis pages; third-party pages say it shows zoning overlays, but no ArcGIS REST services directory was found on it (/rest/services, /arcgis/rest/services, /server/rest/services all 404) and its config is not exposed. ArcGIS Hub/Online searches for Vermillion County zoning returned no zoning service. No city zoning service was found for Clinton, the largest city, either (only third-party Zoneomics pages).
